id-20261003-news-1.title: Gold Prices as the Rupiah Hits Rp18,000 per US Dollar: Why Safe-Haven Assets Are Sought After and What Retail Buyers Should Watch

segments.src: Ketika nilai tukar rupiah melemah ke kisaran Rp18.000 per dolar AS, perhatian banyak rumah tangga beralih ke emas.
segments.tr: When the rupiah exchange rate weakens to the range of Rp18,000 per US dollar, many households turn their attention to gold.

segments.src: Logam mulia ini sudah lama dipandang sebagai tempat berlindung nilai di masa tidak pasti.
segments.tr: This precious metal has long been viewed as a safe haven in uncertain times.

segments.src: Namun, minat yang tinggi tidak otomatis berarti waktu beli yang tepat.
segments.tr: However, high interest does not automatically mean it is the right time to buy.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan hubungan antara kurs, harga minyak, dan harga emas di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: This article explains the relationship between exchange rates, oil prices, and domestic gold prices.

segments.src: Artikel ini juga membahas hal-hal yang sebaiknya dicermati pembeli emas ritel.
segments.tr: This article also discusses things that retail gold buyers should watch out for.

segments.src: *Catatan: tulisan ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat investasi.
segments.tr: *Note: this writing is for general information and is not investment advice.

segments.src: Angka dan kondisi pasar dapat berubah dengan cepat, jadi periksa data terbaru dari sumber resmi sebelum mengambil keputusan.*
segments.tr: Figures and market conditions can change rapidly, so check the latest data from official sources before making decisions.*

segments.src: ## Mengapa emas kembali diminati
segments.tr: ## Why gold is in demand again

segments.src: Ada beberapa faktor yang biasanya mendorong minat pada emas secara bersamaan.
segments.tr: There are several factors that usually drive interest in gold simultaneously.

segments.src: - **Pelemahan rupiah.** Pelemahan mata uang menggerus daya beli, terutama untuk barang impor. Emas dihargai dalam dolar di pasar global, sehingga banyak orang menganggapnya cara menjaga nilai kekayaan.
segments.tr: - **Rupiah depreciation.** Currency weakening erodes purchasing power, especially for imported goods. Gold is priced in dollars on the global market, so many people consider it a way to preserve wealth.

segments.src: - **Harga minyak yang tinggi.** Harga energi yang mahal dapat mendorong inflasi dan menambah tekanan pada neraca perdagangan negara pengimpor minyak. Kekhawatiran inflasi sering meningkatkan minat pada aset lindung nilai.
segments.tr: - **High oil prices.** Expensive energy prices can drive inflation and add pressure to the trade balance of oil-importing countries. Inflation concerns often increase interest in safe-haven assets.

segments.src: - **Ketegangan geopolitik.** Konflik dan ketidakpastian politik internasional membuat investor mengurangi aset berisiko dan mencari aset yang dianggap lebih aman.
segments.tr: - **Geopolitical tensions.** International conflicts and political uncertainty make investors reduce risky assets and seek assets considered safer.

segments.src: - **Ekspektasi suku bunga.** Emas tidak memberi bunga atau dividen. Ketika suku bunga riil turun, daya tarik relatif emas biasanya naik. Sebaliknya, jika suku bunga riil naik, emas bisa tertekan.
segments.tr: - **Interest rate expectations.** Gold does not pay interest or dividends. When real interest rates fall, the relative appeal of gold usually rises. Conversely, if real interest rates rise, gold can come under pressure.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana kurs memengaruhi harga emas domestik
segments.tr: ## How exchange rates affect domestic gold prices

segments.src: Harga emas di Indonesia dipengaruhi dua komponen utama:
segments.tr: Gold prices in Indonesia are influenced by two main components:

segments.src: 1. **Harga emas dunia**, yang dinyatakan dalam dolar AS per troy ounce.
segments.tr: 1. **World gold price**, which is stated in US dollars per troy ounce.

segments.src: 2. **Nilai tukar rupiah terhadap dolar AS.**
segments.tr: 2. **Rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar.**

segments.src: Secara sederhana, harga emas domestik kira-kira mengikuti harga dunia dikalikan kurs, lalu disesuaikan dengan margin penjual, pajak, dan biaya lain.
segments.tr: Simply put, the domestic gold price roughly follows the world price multiplied by the exchange rate, then adjusted for seller margins, taxes, and other costs.

segments.src: Karena itu, harga emas dalam rupiah bisa naik walaupun harga dunia datar, selama rupiah melemah.
segments.tr: Therefore, the price of gold in rupiah can rise even if the world price is flat, as long as the rupiah weakens.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, penguatan rupiah dapat meredam kenaikan harga emas domestik.
segments.tr: Conversely, a strengthening rupiah can dampen the rise in domestic gold prices.

segments.src: Sebagai ilustrasi: jika harga dunia tetap, tetapi kurs bergerak dari Rp16.000 ke Rp18.000, harga dalam rupiah naik sekitar 12,5 persen.
segments.tr: As an illustration: if the world price remains the same, but the exchange rate moves from Rp16,000 to Rp18,000, the price in rupiah rises by about 12.5 percent.

segments.src: Ini hanya perhitungan sederhana.
segments.tr: This is just a simple calculation.

segments.src: Harga di toko emas atau penyedia resmi juga memuat selisih harga jual dan beli serta komponen lainnya.
segments.tr: Prices at gold shops or official providers also include the buy-sell spread and other components.

segments.src: ## Risiko membeli di harga puncak
segments.tr: ## Risks of buying at the peak price

segments.src: Saat berita tentang emas ramai, dorongan untuk ikut membeli biasanya kuat.
segments.tr: When news about gold is buzzing, the urge to join in and buy is usually strong.

segments.src: Ada beberapa risiko yang perlu dipahami.
segments.tr: There are several risks that need to be understood.

segments.src: - **Harga bisa terkoreksi.** Emas tidak naik terus-menerus. Setelah reli panjang, koreksi harga lazim terjadi, dan pembeli di puncak bisa menanggung kerugian di atas kertas selama waktu yang lama.
segments.tr: - **Prices can correct.** Gold does not rise continuously. After a long rally, price corrections are common, and buyers at the peak can bear paper losses for a long time.

segments.src: - **Selisih harga jual dan beli (spread).** Harga beli kembali oleh penjual umumnya lebih rendah daripada harga jual. Emas fisik perlu naik cukup tinggi agar selisih ini tertutup.
segments.tr: - **Buy-sell spread.** The buyback price by sellers is generally lower than the selling price. Physical gold needs to rise high enough for this spread to be covered.

segments.src: - **Biaya tambahan.** Pembelian fisik dapat dikenai biaya cetak, ongkos pembuatan perhiasan, pajak, serta biaya penyimpanan dan asuransi.
segments.tr: - **Additional costs.** Physical purchases can be subject to minting fees, jewelry making costs, taxes, as well as storage and insurance fees.

segments.src: - **Efek ikut-ikutan.** Membeli karena takut tertinggal sering berujung pada keputusan yang tidak terencana dan porsi yang terlalu besar.
segments.tr: - **Bandwagon effect.** Buying because of fear of missing out often leads to unplanned decisions and an overly large portion.

segments.src: - **Kurs bisa berbalik.** Jika rupiah menguat, sebagian keuntungan dari sisi kurs bisa hilang.
segments.tr: - **Exchange rates can reverse.** If the rupiah strengthens, some of the gains from the exchange rate side can be lost.

segments.src: ## Hal yang perlu dicermati pembeli emas ritel
segments.tr: ## Things retail gold buyers should watch

segments.src: Tentukan tujuan dan jangka waktu.** Emas cocok sebagai penyimpan nilai jangka menengah hingga panjang.
segments.tr: Determine goals and time horizon.** Gold is suitable as a medium to long-term store of value.

segments.src: Jika dana akan dipakai dalam waktu dekat, fluktuasi harga bisa menjadi masalah.
segments.tr: If funds will be used in the near future, price fluctuations can be a problem.

segments.src: Atur porsi.** Banyak perencana keuangan menyarankan emas sebagai bagian dari portofolio yang terdiversifikasi, bukan satu-satunya aset.
segments.tr: Manage the portion.** Many financial planners suggest gold as part of a diversified portfolio, not the only asset.

segments.src: Jangan menggunakan dana darurat atau uang pinjaman.
segments.tr: Do not use emergency funds or borrowed money.

segments.src: Pertimbangkan pembelian bertahap.** Membeli secara berkala dengan nominal tetap membantu meratakan harga beli dan mengurangi risiko salah menebak waktu.
segments.tr: Consider gradual purchases.** Buying periodically with a fixed nominal amount helps smooth out the purchase price and reduces the risk of mistiming the market.

segments.src: Pilih penjual yang resmi dan tepercaya.** Pastikan emas disertai sertifikat, kadar dan berat yang jelas, serta asal penjual yang dapat diverifikasi.
segments.tr: Choose an official and trusted seller.** Ensure the gold comes with a certificate, clear purity and weight, and a verifiable seller origin.

segments.src: Waspadai tawaran dengan harga jauh di bawah pasar atau janji keuntungan pasti.
segments.tr: Be wary of offers with prices far below market or promises of guaranteed returns.

segments.src: Bandingkan bentuk emas.** Emas batangan umumnya memiliki biaya tambahan lebih rendah daripada perhiasan.
segments.tr: Compare gold forms.** Gold bars generally have lower additional costs than jewelry.

segments.src: Emas digital atau produk tabungan emas praktis, tetapi periksa legalitas penyelenggara, biaya, dan syarat penarikan fisiknya.
segments.tr: Digital gold or gold savings products are practical, but check the legality of the provider, fees, and physical withdrawal terms.

segments.src: Pahami biaya dan pajak.** Tanyakan semua biaya di muka, termasuk selisih harga jual dan beli, serta ketentuan pajak yang berlaku saat membeli maupun menjual.
segments.tr: Understand costs and taxes.** Ask about all costs upfront, including the buy-sell spread, as well as tax provisions that apply when buying or selling.

segments.src: Simpan dengan aman.** Emas fisik perlu tempat penyimpanan yang aman.
segments.tr: Store safely.** Physical gold needs a secure storage place.

segments.src: Pertimbangkan brankas atau layanan titipan resmi.
segments.tr: Consider a safe or an official deposit service.

segments.src: Pantau indikator, tetapi jangan terobsesi.** Perhatikan harga emas dunia, kurs rupiah, arah suku bunga, dan perkembangan inflasi.
segments.tr: Monitor indicators, but don't be obsessed.** Pay attention to world gold prices, rupiah exchange rates, interest rate directions, and inflation developments.

segments.src: Meski begitu, tidak ada yang dapat memprediksi harga dengan pasti.
segments.tr: Even so, no one can predict prices with certainty.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Pelemahan rupiah, harga minyak yang tinggi, dan ketegangan geopolitik memang memperkuat daya tarik emas sebagai lindung nilai.
segments.tr: Rupiah depreciation, high oil prices, and geopolitical tensions do strengthen the appeal of gold as a hedge.

segments.src: Namun, harga emas domestik juga mencerminkan kurs, sehingga membeli saat berita sedang ramai bisa berarti membeli di harga yang sudah tinggi.
segments.tr: However, domestic gold prices also reflect exchange rates, so buying when news is buzzing can mean buying at an already high price.

segments.src: Pembeli ritel sebaiknya membeli sesuai tujuan dan kemampuan keuangan, dengan porsi yang wajar, secara bertahap, dan melalui penjual yang tepercaya.
segments.tr: Retail buyers should buy according to their goals and financial capacity, with a reasonable portion, gradually, and through trusted sellers.

segments.src: Jika ragu, konsultasikan dengan perencana keuangan berlisensi.
segments.tr: If in doubt, consult a licensed financial planner.

id-20261003-news-2.title: October 2026 Transitional Season: Flood Alert, Forest Fires, and Extreme Weather Amidst Seasonal Shift

segments.src: Oktober kerap disebut sebagai bulan pancaroba, masa peralihan dari musim kemarau ke musim hujan.
segments.tr: October is often called the transition month, the period of shifting from the dry season to the rainy season.

segments.src: Di Indonesia, peralihan ini tidak terjadi serentak.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, this transition does not happen simultaneously.

segments.src: Sebagian wilayah masih kering dan rawan kebakaran lahan, sementara wilayah lain sudah mulai diguyur hujan lebat disertai angin kencang.
segments.tr: Some regions are still dry and prone to land fires, while other regions are starting to experience heavy rain accompanied by strong winds.

segments.src: Kondisi ini membuat risiko bencana menjadi ganda dan menuntut kesiapsiagaan dari pemerintah daerah maupun warga.
segments.tr: This condition creates dual disaster risks and demands preparedness from both local governments and residents.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum. Untuk prakiraan cuaca terbaru dan peringatan dini resmi, rujuklah selalu BMKG (bmkg.go.id), BNPB, serta BPBD di daerah masing-masing.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is for general information. For the latest weather forecasts and official early warnings, always refer to BMKG (bmkg.go.id), BNPB, and BPBD in your respective regions.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Pancaroba Rawan Cuaca Ekstrem?
segments.tr: ## Why is the Transitional Season Prone to Extreme Weather?

segments.src: Pada masa peralihan, pola angin berubah dan pemanasan permukaan bumi cenderung kuat.
segments.tr: During the transition period, wind patterns change and earth surface heating tends to be strong.

segments.src: Akibatnya, atmosfer menjadi labil dan awan konvektif tumbuh dengan cepat.
segments.tr: As a result, the atmosphere becomes unstable and convective clouds grow rapidly.

segments.src: Beberapa ciri yang lazim muncul:
segments.tr: Several common characteristics that emerge:

segments.src: - **Pagi hingga siang cerah dan terik**, lalu menjelang sore atau malam turun hujan lebat secara tiba-tiba.
segments.tr: - **Morning to afternoon is clear and sunny**, then towards late afternoon or evening, heavy rain falls suddenly.

segments.src: - **Hujan disertai petir dan angin kencang** yang berlangsung singkat namun lokal.
segments.tr: - **Rain accompanied by lightning and strong winds** that are brief yet local.

segments.src: - **Potensi angin puting beliung** serta hujan es di beberapa lokasi.
segments.tr: - **Potential for tornadoes** and hail in several locations.

segments.src: - **Perbedaan kondisi antarwilayah** yang tajam: satu kota basah, kota di dekatnya masih kering.
segments.tr: - **Sharp differences in conditions between regions**: one city is wet, a nearby city is still dry.

segments.src: Awal musim hujan juga tidak sama di setiap daerah.
segments.tr: The start of the rainy season is also not the same in every region.

segments.src: Karena itu, warga perlu mengikuti informasi lokal, bukan hanya gambaran nasional.
segments.tr: Therefore, residents need to follow local information, not just national overviews.

segments.src: ## Dua Risiko yang Berjalan Bersamaan
segments.tr: ## Two Risks Occurring Simultaneously

segments.src: ### 1. Wilayah yang Masih Kering: Karhutla dan Kabut Asap
segments.tr: ### 1. Regions That Are Still Dry: Forest/Land Fires and Haze

segments.src: Di daerah yang hujannya belum turun merata, terutama wilayah dengan lahan gambut dan perkebunan, titik panas masih mungkin muncul.
segments.tr: In areas where rain has not fallen evenly, especially peatland and plantation areas, hotspots may still appear.

segments.src: Lahan yang kering mudah terbakar dan api sulit dipadamkan, apalagi bila ada angin.
segments.tr: Dry land easily catches fire and the fire is difficult to extinguish, especially if there is wind.

segments.src: Dampaknya dapat meluas menjadi:
segments.tr: The impact can expand into:

segments.src: - kabut asap yang menurunkan kualitas udara dan jarak pandang,
segments.tr: - haze that reduces air quality and visibility,

segments.src: - gangguan kesehatan, terutama infeksi saluran pernapasan pada anak, lansia, dan penderita asma,
segments.tr: - health disorders, especially respiratory infections in children, the elderly, and asthma sufferers,

segments.src: - gangguan transportasi darat, laut, dan udara.
segments.tr: - disruption of land, sea, and air transportation.

segments.src: ### 2. Wilayah yang Mulai Hujan: Banjir, Longsor, dan Angin Kencang
segments.tr: ### 2. Regions Starting to Rain: Floods, Landslides, and Strong Winds

segments.src: Hujan pertama setelah kemarau panjang sering membawa limpasan besar.
segments.tr: The first rain after a long drought often brings large runoff.

segments.src: Tanah yang mengeras kurang mampu menyerap air, sementara saluran drainase kerap tersumbat sampah dan sedimen.
segments.tr: Hardened soil is less able to absorb water, while drainage channels are frequently clogged with garbage and sediment.

segments.src: Risiko yang perlu diwaspadai antara lain:
segments.tr: Risks that need to be watched out for include:

segments.src: - banjir dan genangan di kawasan perkotaan serta bantaran sungai,
segments.tr: - floods and puddles in urban areas and riverbanks,

segments.src: - banjir bandang dan tanah longsor di daerah perbukitan,
segments.tr: - flash floods and land landslides in hilly areas,

segments.src: - pohon tumbang, baliho roboh, dan atap rumah rusak akibat angin kencang.
segments.tr: - fallen trees, collapsed billboards, and damaged house roofs due to strong winds.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Disiapkan Pemerintah Daerah
segments.tr: ## What Local Governments Need to Prepare

segments.src: 1. **Memantau peringatan dini.** Pastikan informasi BMKG diteruskan cepat ke kecamatan, desa, dan kelurahan melalui kanal yang mudah diakses warga.
segments.tr: 1. **Monitor early warnings.** Ensure BMKG information is passed on quickly to sub-districts, villages, and urban communities through channels easily accessible by residents.

segments.src: 2. **Membersihkan drainase dan sungai.** Normalisasi saluran air, pengerukan sedimen, dan pembersihan sampah sebaiknya selesai sebelum hujan deras datang.
segments.tr: 2. **Clean drainage and rivers.** Water channel normalization, sediment dredging, and garbage cleanup should be completed before heavy rain arrives.

segments.src: 3. **Menyiapkan posko dan logistik.** Periksa kesiapan tempat evakuasi, perahu karet, pompa air, genset, tenda, makanan, obat-obatan, dan air bersih.
segments.tr: 3. **Prepare posts and logistics.** Check the readiness of evacuation sites, rubber boats, water pumps, generators, tents, food, medicines, and clean water.

segments.src: 4. **Mencegah dan memadamkan karhutla.** Perkuat patroli, pembasahan lahan gambut, sekat kanal, serta pengawasan pembukaan lahan dengan cara membakar. Penegakan aturan dan edukasi masyarakat berjalan beriringan.
segments.tr: 4. **Prevent and extinguish land fires.** Strengthen patrols, peatland wetting, canal blocking, and supervision of land clearing by burning. Law enforcement and community education go hand in hand.

segments.src: 5. **Memangkas pohon rawan tumbang** dan memeriksa konstruksi reklame serta tiang di sepanjang jalan.
segments.tr: 5. **Prune trees prone to falling** and check the construction of billboards and poles along roadsides.

segments.src: 6. **Menggelar simulasi evakuasi** dan memastikan jalur serta titik kumpul dikenal warga.
segments.tr: 6. **Hold evacuation simulations** and ensure routes and assembly points are known by residents.

segments.src: 7. **Menyiapkan layanan kesehatan.** Antisipasi lonjakan kasus ISPA, diare, demam berdarah, dan penyakit pascabanjir.
segments.tr: 7. **Prepare health services.** Anticipate surges in cases of acute respiratory infection (ARI), diarrhea, dengue fever, and post-flood diseases.

segments.src: ## Yang Dapat Dilakukan Warga
segments.tr: ## What Residents Can Do

segments.src: ### Di rumah dan lingkungan
segments.tr: ### At home and surroundings

segments.src: - Bersihkan selokan, talang, dan saluran di sekitar rumah; jangan membuang sampah ke sungai.
segments.tr: - Clean gutters, eaves, and channels around the house; do not throw garbage into rivers.

segments.src: - Periksa kondisi atap, plafon, dan pohon besar di sekitar rumah.
segments.tr: - Check the condition of roofs, ceilings, and large trees around the house.

segments.src: - Kuras dan tutup tempat penampungan air untuk mencegah jentik nyamuk, karena awal musim hujan sering diikuti naiknya kasus demam berdarah.
segments.tr: - Drain and cover water reservoirs to prevent mosquito larvae, as the start of the rainy season is often followed by a rise in dengue fever cases.

segments.src: - Simpan dokumen penting dalam wadah kedap air.
segments.tr: - Store important documents in waterproof containers.

segments.src: ### Menyiapkan tas siaga
segments.tr: ### Preparing an emergency bag

segments.src: - Senter dan baterai cadangan, power bank, radio kecil.
segments.tr: - Flashlight and spare batteries, power bank, small radio.

segments.src: - Obat pribadi, P3K, masker, dan perlengkapan bayi bila perlu.
segments.tr: - Personal medication, first aid kit, masks, and baby supplies if necessary.

segments.src: - Air minum dan makanan tahan lama untuk beberapa hari.
segments.tr: - Drinking water and long-lasting food for a few days.

segments.src: - Salinan kartu identitas dan nomor kontak darurat.
segments.tr: - Copies of ID cards and emergency contact numbers.

segments.src: ### Saat hujan lebat dan angin kencang
segments.tr: ### During heavy rain and strong winds

segments.src: - Hindari berteduh di bawah pohon besar, baliho, atau tiang.
segments.tr: - Avoid sheltering under large trees, billboards, or poles.

segments.src: - Cabut peralatan listrik bila air mulai masuk rumah, dan matikan aliran listrik utama jika aman dilakukan.
segments.tr: - Unplug electrical appliances if water starts entering the house, and turn off the main electricity supply if safe to do so.

segments.src: - Jangan menerobos arus banjir atau genangan yang dalam, baik berjalan kaki maupun berkendara.
segments.tr: - Do not wade through flood currents or deep puddles, whether walking or driving.

segments.src: - Segera menjauh dari lereng dan tebing bila hujan deras berlangsung lama atau muncul retakan tanah.
segments.tr: - Immediately move away from slopes and cliffs if heavy rain lasts a long time or soil cracks appear.

segments.src: ### Di wilayah rawan kebakaran lahan dan asap
segments.tr: ### In land fire and smoke-prone areas

segments.src: - Jangan membakar sampah atau lahan, dan jangan membuang puntung rokok sembarangan.
segments.tr: - Do not burn garbage or land, and do not throw cigarette butts carelessly.

segments.src: - Laporkan titik api ke aparat desa, BPBD, atau petugas pemadam setempat.
segments.tr: - Report hotspots to village apparatus, BPBD, or local firefighters.

segments.src: - Gunakan masker yang sesuai saat kualitas udara memburuk, kurangi aktivitas luar ruang, dan tutup ventilasi bila perlu.
segments.tr: - Use appropriate masks when air quality worsens, reduce outdoor activities, and close ventilation if necessary.

segments.src: - Kelompok rentan sebaiknya berkonsultasi dengan tenaga kesehatan bila muncul sesak atau batuk berkepanjangan.
segments.tr: - Vulnerable groups should consult health workers if shortness of breath or prolonged coughing occurs.

segments.src: ## Bagi Pelaku Pertanian dan Perjalanan
segments.tr: ## For Agriculture and Travel Practitioners

segments.src: Petani perlu menyesuaikan jadwal tanam dengan prakiraan awal musim hujan dari BMKG dan penyuluh setempat, serta menyiapkan saluran pembuangan agar lahan tidak tergenang.
segments.tr: Farmers need to adjust planting schedules with the early rainy season forecast from BMKG and local extension workers, and prepare drainage channels so land does not get waterlogged.

segments.src: Pemudik dan wisatawan sebaiknya memeriksa prakiraan cuaca dan kondisi jalan sebelum berangkat, terutama di jalur pegunungan, kawasan pesisir, dan perairan, karena gelombang tinggi dapat mengganggu pelayaran.
segments.tr: Homecomers and tourists should check weather forecasts and road conditions before leaving, especially on mountain routes, coastal areas, and waters, because high waves can disrupt shipping.

segments.src: ## Waspada Informasi yang Belum Terverifikasi
segments.tr: ## Beware of Unverified Information

segments.src: Saat cuaca ekstrem, kabar yang beredar di media sosial dan aplikasi pesan sering tidak akurat, misalnya klaim prediksi bencana pada tanggal tertentu.
segments.tr: During extreme weather, news circulating on social media and messaging apps is often inaccurate, such as claims of disaster predictions on certain dates.

segments.src: Pastikan informasi berasal dari sumber resmi sebelum disebarkan agar tidak menimbulkan kepanikan.
segments.tr: Make sure information comes from official sources before spreading it so as not to cause panic.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Pancaroba Oktober 2026 mengingatkan bahwa kesiapsiagaan bukan hanya soal merespons bencana, tetapi mencegahnya sejak dini.
segments.tr: The October 2026 transition reminds us that preparedness is not just about responding to disasters, but preventing them early on.

segments.src: Dengan drainase yang bersih, pencegahan karhutla, pemantauan informasi resmi, serta kebiasaan siaga di tingkat keluarga, dampak peralihan musim dapat ditekan.
segments.tr: With clean drainage, land fire prevention, monitoring of official information, and preparedness habits at the family level, the impact of the seasonal shift can be suppressed.

segments.src: Kuncinya adalah koordinasi antara pemerintah daerah dan warga, serta kemauan untuk bersiap sebelum hujan atau api datang.
segments.tr: The key is coordination between local governments and residents, as well as the willingness to prepare before rain or fire arrives.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun sebagai informasi umum dan tidak menggantikan arahan resmi dari otoritas kebencanaan dan meteorologi.*
segments.tr: *This article is compiled as general information and does not replace official directions from disaster and meteorological authorities.*

id-20261003-news-3.title: Overseeing the MBG Program Kitchen: Food Safety Standards and Laboratory Testing to Prevent Mass Poisoning

segments.src: Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) memiliki tujuan yang jelas: memperbaiki asupan gizi anak sekolah, ibu hamil, dan kelompok rentan lainnya.
segments.tr: The Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program has a clear goal: to improve the nutritional intake of school children, pregnant women, and other vulnerable groups.

segments.src: Namun, skala program yang sangat besar membawa tantangan yang sama besarnya.
segments.tr: However, the massive scale of the program brings equally significant challenges.

segments.src: Ketika sejumlah laporan dugaan keracunan pangan muncul di beberapa daerah, perhatian publik beralih dari soal jumlah porsi ke pertanyaan yang lebih mendasar: seberapa kuat sistem pengawasan di dapur penyedia?
segments.tr: When a number of reports of suspected food poisoning emerged in several regions, public attention shifted from the number of portions to a more fundamental question: how strong is the oversight system in the provider's kitchen?

segments.src: Artikel ini mengulas langkah-langkah perbaikan yang realistis, dengan fokus pada dapur Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG), yaitu unit yang memasak dan mendistribusikan makanan setiap hari.
segments.tr: This article reviews realistic improvement steps, focusing on the Nutrition Fulfillment Service Unit (SPPG) kitchens, which are the units that cook and distribute food daily.

segments.src: Penting dicatat bahwa penyebab setiap kasus berbeda-beda dan penentuannya merupakan wewenang pemeriksaan resmi.
segments.tr: It is important to note that the cause of each case varies and its determination is the authority of official investigations.

segments.src: Pembahasan di sini bersifat umum dan tidak menuduh pihak tertentu.
segments.tr: The discussion here is general and does not accuse any specific party.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Dapur Skala Besar Rentan
segments.tr: ## Why Large-Scale Kitchens Are Vulnerable

segments.src: Memasak untuk ratusan hingga ribuan porsi dalam satu waktu berbeda jauh dari memasak rumah tangga.
segments.tr: Cooking for hundreds to thousands of portions at one time is very different from household cooking.

segments.src: Beberapa faktor risiko yang lazim ditemukan dalam penyediaan makanan massal:
segments.tr: Several risk factors commonly found in mass food provision:

segments.src: - **Jeda waktu antara memasak dan menyantap.** Makanan yang dimasak dini hari lalu dikonsumsi beberapa jam kemudian berada lama di rentang suhu berbahaya (sekitar 5–60 °C), saat bakteri berkembang cepat.
segments.tr: - **Time gap between cooking and eating.** Food cooked early in the morning and consumed several hours later stays for a long time in the dangerous temperature range (around 5–60 °C), when bacteria multiply rapidly.

segments.src: - **Volume bahan baku besar.** Protein hewani, santan, dan sayuran segar membutuhkan penyimpanan dan penanganan ketat.
segments.tr: - **Large volume of raw materials.** Animal protein, coconut milk, and fresh vegetables require strict storage and handling.

segments.src: - **Beban kerja tinggi dan tenaga baru.** Penjamah makanan yang belum terlatih lebih mudah melewatkan langkah kebersihan dasar.
segments.tr: - **High workload and new staff.** Untrained food handlers are more likely to skip basic hygiene steps.

segments.src: - **Rantai distribusi panjang.** Wadah, kendaraan, dan lama perjalanan memengaruhi kondisi makanan saat tiba.
segments.tr: - **Long distribution chains.** Containers, vehicles, and travel time affect the condition of the food upon arrival.

segments.src: ## Pilar Pertama: Sertifikasi Higiene dan Sanitasi
segments.tr: ## First Pillar: Hygiene and Sanitation Certification

segments.src: Di Indonesia, usaha jasa boga telah memiliki acuan, antara lain Sertifikat Laik Higiene Sanitasi (SLHS) yang diterbitkan melalui dinas kesehatan setempat.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, catering businesses already have references, including the Hygiene Sanitation Feasibility Certificate (SLHS) issued through the local health office.

segments.src: Agar sertifikasi tidak berhenti sebagai formalitas administratif, beberapa langkah berikut layak diperkuat:
segments.tr: For certification not to end up as an administrative formality, the following steps are worth strengthening:

segments.src: 1. **Sertifikat sebagai syarat operasional, bukan pelengkap.** Dapur baru memulai produksi setelah inspeksi lokasi dinyatakan memenuhi syarat.
segments.tr: 1. **Certificate as an operational requirement, not a supplement.** Kitchens only start production after the site inspection is declared compliant.

segments.src: 2. **Pelatihan penjamah makanan yang berulang.** Materi mencakup cuci tangan, pemisahan bahan mentah dan matang, serta pengendalian suhu.
segments.tr: 2. **Recurring food handler training.** Materials include hand washing, separation of raw and cooked ingredients, and temperature control.

segments.src: 3. **Penerapan prinsip HACCP secara sederhana.** Setiap dapur memetakan titik kritis, misalnya suhu pemasakan, waktu penyimpanan, dan kebersihan peralatan, lalu mencatatnya harian.
segments.tr: 3. **Simple implementation of HACCP principles.** Each kitchen maps critical points, such as cooking temperature, storage time, and equipment cleanliness, then records them daily.

segments.src: 4. **Audit berkala dan tak terjadwal.** Inspeksi mendadak lebih menggambarkan kondisi sebenarnya dibanding kunjungan yang diumumkan jauh hari.
segments.tr: 4. **Periodic and unannounced audits.** Surprise inspections better reflect actual conditions compared to visits announced well in advance.

segments.src: 5. **Evaluasi ulang secara berkala.** Sertifikat perlu ditinjau ulang, terutama jika kapasitas produksi dapur meningkat.
segments.tr: 5. **Periodic re-evaluation.** Certificates need to be reviewed, especially if the kitchen's production capacity increases.

segments.src: ## Pilar Kedua: Rantai Pasok Bahan Baku
segments.tr: ## Second Pillar: Raw Material Supply Chain

segments.src: Keamanan pangan dimulai sebelum bahan masuk dapur.
segments.tr: Food safety begins before ingredients enter the kitchen.

segments.src: Karena itu pengawasan perlu mencakup pemasok:
segments.tr: Therefore, oversight needs to include suppliers:

segments.src: - **Seleksi dan daftar pemasok terverifikasi**, dengan kriteria mutu dan kebersihan yang tertulis.
segments.tr: - **Selection and list of verified suppliers**, with written quality and hygiene criteria.

segments.src: - **Pemeriksaan saat penerimaan barang**: suhu daging dan ikan, tanggal kedaluwarsa, kondisi kemasan, dan kesegaran sayuran.
segments.tr: - **Inspection upon receipt of goods**: meat and fish temperature, expiration dates, packaging condition, and vegetable freshness.

segments.src: - **Penyimpanan sesuai jenis bahan**: rantai dingin untuk produk mudah rusak dan sistem first-in, first-out.
segments.tr: - **Storage according to ingredient type**: cold chain for perishable products and a first-in, first-out system.

segments.src: - **Ketertelusuran (traceability).** Setiap bahan dicatat asal dan nomor batchnya agar, bila ada masalah, sumbernya dapat dilacak dengan cepat.
segments.tr: - **Traceability.** Each ingredient's origin and batch number are recorded so that, if there is a problem, the source can be tracked quickly.

segments.src: - **Diversifikasi pemasok lokal** dengan pendampingan mutu, sehingga program tetap mendukung petani dan UMKM tanpa menurunkan standar.
segments.tr: - **Diversification of local suppliers** with quality mentoring, so the program continues to support farmers and MSMEs without lowering standards.

segments.src: ## Pilar Ketiga: Uji Laboratorium yang Terukur
segments.tr: ## Third Pillar: Measurable Laboratory Testing

segments.src: Uji laboratorium memberi bukti objektif yang tidak bisa digantikan penilaian visual.
segments.tr: Laboratory testing provides objective evidence that cannot be replaced by visual assessment.

segments.src: Pendekatan yang realistis adalah berbasis risiko, bukan menguji segalanya setiap hari.
segments.tr: A realistic approach is risk-based, rather than testing everything every day.

segments.src: - **Pengujian sampel makanan jadi** untuk parameter mikrobiologi seperti *Salmonella*, *E. coli*, dan *Staphylococcus aureus*.
segments.tr: - **Testing finished food samples** for microbiological parameters such as *Salmonella*, *E. coli*, and *Staphylococcus aureus*.

segments.src: - **Pengujian air** yang dipakai untuk memasak dan mencuci, serta **usap permukaan** (swab) pada alat dan meja kerja.
segments.tr: - **Testing water** used for cooking and washing, as well as **surface swabs** on tools and work tables.

segments.src: - **Sampel pertinggal (retained sample).** Setiap menu disimpan dalam jumlah kecil pada suhu aman selama periode tertentu, sehingga jika muncul gejala sakit, pemeriksaan penyebab dapat dilakukan lebih cepat dan akurat.
segments.tr: - **Retained samples.** Each menu is stored in small quantities at a safe temperature for a certain period, so that if illness symptoms appear, the investigation of the cause can be done faster and more accurately.

segments.src: - **Pemanfaatan jejaring laboratorium** daerah, seperti laboratorium kesehatan daerah, balai pengawas obat dan makanan, dan laboratorium perguruan tinggi, agar akses tidak terpusat di kota besar.
segments.tr: - **Utilization of regional laboratory networks**, such as regional health laboratories, food and drug supervisory agencies, and university laboratories, so that access is not centralized in big cities.

segments.src: - **Uji cepat (rapid test) sebagai penyaring awal**, dengan konfirmasi laboratorium untuk temuan yang mencurigakan.
segments.tr: - **Rapid tests as an initial screening**, with laboratory confirmation for suspicious findings.

segments.src: ## Pilar Keempat: Transparansi dan Akuntabilitas
segments.tr: ## Fourth Pillar: Transparency and Accountability

segments.src: Kepercayaan publik tumbuh ketika informasi mudah diakses.
segments.tr: Public trust grows when information is easily accessible.

segments.src: Beberapa praktik yang dapat dipertimbangkan:
segments.tr: Some practices that can be considered:

segments.src: - **Publikasi ringkasan hasil inspeksi dan uji** per dapur dalam bahasa yang dipahami orang tua dan sekolah, tanpa membuka data pribadi pihak mana pun.
segments.tr: - **Publication of inspection and test result summaries** per kitchen in language understood by parents and schools, without disclosing any party's personal data.

segments.src: - **Papan informasi sertifikasi** di dapur dan sekolah penerima.
segments.tr: - **Certification information boards** in kitchens and recipient schools.

segments.src: - **Kanal pengaduan yang mudah**, misalnya nomor telepon atau pesan singkat, dengan janji waktu tanggapan yang jelas.
segments.tr: - **Easy complaint channels**, such as telephone numbers or text messages, with clear response time promises.

segments.src: - **Protokol penanganan insiden yang baku**: pemisahan makanan yang dicurigai, penanganan medis segera, pelaporan ke dinas kesehatan, dan penyampaian informasi yang akurat kepada keluarga.
segments.tr: - **Standard incident handling protocols**: separation of suspected food, immediate medical handling, reporting to the health office, and providing accurate information to families.

segments.src: - **Laporan evaluasi pascakejadian** yang memuat temuan dan perbaikan, agar pelajaran dari satu daerah dapat dipakai daerah lain.
segments.tr: - **Post-incident evaluation reports** containing findings and improvements, so lessons from one region can be used by others.

segments.src: ## Peran Sekolah dan Orang Tua
segments.tr: ## The Role of Schools and Parents

segments.src: Pengawasan tidak hanya tugas pemerintah.
segments.tr: Oversight is not just the government's job.

segments.src: Guru dan pengelola sekolah dapat mengecek tampilan, aroma, dan suhu makanan sebelum dibagikan, serta menahan penyajian bila ada kejanggalan.
segments.tr: Teachers and school administrators can check the appearance, aroma, and temperature of food before it is distributed, and withhold serving if there are irregularities.

segments.src: Orang tua dapat memberi umpan balik dan melaporkan gejala yang muncul setelah makan, termasuk riwayat alergi anak, agar penanganan lebih tepat.
segments.tr: Parents can provide feedback and report symptoms that appear after eating, including the child's allergy history, so that handling is more precise.

segments.src: ## Tantangan Pelaksanaan
segments.tr: ## Implementation Challenges

segments.src: Perbaikan di atas tentu membutuhkan sumber daya.
segments.tr: The improvements above certainly require resources.

segments.src: Jumlah dapur yang cepat bertambah dapat melampaui kapasitas inspektur dan laboratorium.
segments.tr: The rapidly increasing number of kitchens can exceed the capacity of inspectors and laboratories.

segments.src: Karena itu, prioritas perlu ditetapkan: dapur berkapasitas besar atau berisiko tinggi diperiksa lebih sering, sementara pelatihan dan sistem pencatatan digital sederhana membantu pengawasan menjangkau lebih luas.
segments.tr: Therefore, priorities need to be set: large-capacity or high-risk kitchens are inspected more frequently, while training and simple digital recording systems help oversight reach further.

segments.src: Pendanaan untuk peralatan seperti lemari pendingin, termometer, dan fasilitas cuci juga perlu dipastikan sejak awal, bukan menjadi beban tambahan bagi pengelola dapur.
segments.tr: Funding for equipment such as refrigerators, thermometers, and washing facilities also needs to be ensured from the start, not becoming an additional burden for kitchen managers.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Keracunan massal hampir selalu merupakan hasil dari beberapa celah kecil yang bertemu: suhu yang kurang terjaga, bahan yang tidak tertelusuri, atau pencatatan yang terlewat.
segments.tr: Mass poisoning is almost always the result of several small gaps meeting: poorly maintained temperatures, untraceable ingredients, or missed recording.

segments.src: Menutup celah-celah itu melalui sertifikasi yang bermakna, rantai pasok yang terverifikasi, uji laboratorium berbasis risiko, dan transparansi hasil adalah langkah yang realistis dan dapat dimulai sekarang.
segments.tr: Closing those gaps through meaningful certification, verified supply chains, risk-based laboratory testing, and result transparency is a realistic step that can be started now.

segments.src: Dengan pengawasan yang konsisten, tujuan mulia program MBG, yakni anak-anak yang sehat dan tercukupi gizinya, dapat tercapai tanpa mengorbankan keselamatan mereka.
segments.tr: With consistent oversight, the noble goal of the MBG program, namely healthy and well-nourished children, can be achieved without sacrificing their safety.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan nasihat medis atau hukum.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is informative and not medical or legal advice.

segments.src: Untuk informasi resmi mengenai kasus tertentu, rujuklah pernyataan dinas kesehatan, badan pengawas pangan, dan instansi berwenang.*
segments.tr: For official information regarding specific cases, refer to statements from the health office, food supervisory agency, and authorized institutions.*

id-20261003-intro-retail-15.title: [Retail #15] From the Corner Shop to the Algorithm: Where Is Indonesian Retail Heading?

segments.src: > Ritel masa depan bukan soal toko fisik versus online, melainkan soal siapa yang paling paham pelanggan lewat data — dan kuliah penutup ini merangkum seluruh peta jalannya.
segments.tr: > The future of retail is not about physical stores versus online, but rather about who understands the customer best through data — and this closing lecture summarizes the entire roadmap.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Selama empat belas pertemuan kita membedah ritel dari berbagai sisi.
segments.tr: Over our fourteen meetings, we have dissected retail from various angles.

segments.src: Pertemuan ke-15 ini punya dua tugas: mengenalkan **retail tech** (teknologi ritel) dan **kebijakan perdagangan**, lalu merangkai semuanya jadi satu gambar utuh.
segments.tr: This 15th meeting has two tasks: introducing **retail tech** (retail technology) and **trade policy**, and then weaving everything together into a single picture.

segments.src: Kalau kamu baru bergabung di sini, tenang — semua istilah dijelaskan dari nol.
segments.tr: If you are just joining us here, don't worry — all terms are explained from scratch.

segments.src: ### Bagian 1: Retail tech, alias teknologi yang mengubah cara orang belanja
segments.tr: ### Part 1: Retail tech, aka the technology changing how people shop

segments.src: Ada empat gelombang teknologi yang paling terasa di lapangan:
segments.tr: There are four technology waves most felt in the field:

segments.src: Data pelanggan jadi bahan bakar.** Dulu pemilik toko mengenal pelanggannya lewat ingatan ("Bu Sri biasanya beli minyak goreng dua liter").
segments.tr: Customer data becomes fuel.** In the past, store owners knew their customers through memory ("Mrs. Sri usually buys two liters of cooking oil").

segments.src: Sekarang ingatan itu digantikan sistem: kartu member, aplikasi, riwayat transaksi.
segments.tr: Now that memory is replaced by systems: member cards, apps, transaction history.

segments.src: Dari situ lahir *personalisasi* — rekomendasi produk, promo yang berbeda untuk tiap orang.
segments.tr: From there, *personalization* is born — product recommendations, different promos for each person.

segments.src: Omnichannel.** Artinya toko fisik, aplikasi, marketplace, dan media sosial diperlakukan sebagai satu saluran yang saling terhubung, bukan bisnis terpisah.
segments.tr: Omnichannel.** This means physical stores, apps, marketplaces, and social media are treated as a single interconnected channel, not separate businesses.

segments.src: Contoh paling umum: beli lewat aplikasi, ambil di gerai terdekat.
segments.tr: The most common example: buy via app, pick up at the nearest outlet.

segments.src: Lawannya adalah *multichannel*, di mana tiap saluran jalan sendiri-sendiri dan stoknya pun tidak saling tahu.
segments.tr: The opposite is *multichannel*, where each channel runs independently and their stocks do not even know each other.

segments.src: Otomasi rantai pasok dan gudang.** Peramalan permintaan, penataan stok, sampai pengaturan rute kurir kini dibantu perangkat lunak.
segments.tr: Supply chain and warehouse automation.** Demand forecasting, inventory arrangement, and even courier route planning are now assisted by software.

segments.src: Tujuannya sederhana: mengurangi dua penyakit klasik ritel — *stockout* (barang habis padahal ada yang mau beli) dan *overstock* (barang menumpuk lalu kedaluwarsa).
segments.tr: The goal is simple: reduce two classic retail illnesses — *stockout* (items running out when someone wants to buy) and *overstock* (items piling up and then expiring).

segments.src: Pembayaran digital dan social commerce.** QRIS membuat warung kecil bisa menerima pembayaran nontunai tanpa mesin EDC mahal.
segments.tr: Digital payments and social commerce.** QRIS allows small shops to accept cashless payments without an expensive EDC machine.

segments.src: Sementara itu, penjualan lewat siaran langsung di media sosial menjadikan hiburan dan belanja satu paket.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, sales via live streams on social media make entertainment and shopping a package deal.

segments.src: ### Bagian 2: Kebijakan perdagangan — pagar yang mengatur permainan
segments.tr: ### Part 2: Trade policy — the fence that governs the game

segments.src: Ritel bukan pasar bebas tanpa aturan.
segments.tr: Retail is not a free market without rules.

segments.src: Beberapa jenis kebijakan yang perlu kamu kenal:
segments.tr: Several types of policies you need to know:

segments.src: - **Perizinan dan penataan lokasi.** Pemerintah daerah mengatur di mana toko modern boleh berdiri dan seberapa dekat dengan pasar rakyat. Tujuannya menjaga ruang hidup pedagang kecil.
segments.tr: - **Licensing and location arrangement.** Local governments regulate where modern stores can be established and how close they are to traditional markets. The goal is to protect the living space of small traders.

segments.src: - **Aturan kemitraan dan pemasokan.** Ada ketentuan soal syarat dagang antara peritel besar dan pemasok kecil, termasuk batas biaya-biaya yang boleh dibebankan, agar posisi tawar tidak timpang.
segments.tr: - **Partnership and supply rules.** There are provisions regarding trading terms between large retailers and small suppliers, including limits on fees that can be charged, so that the bargaining position is not unbalanced.

segments.src: - **Perlindungan konsumen.** Kewajiban mencantumkan harga, label bahasa Indonesia, informasi kedaluwarsa, serta hak komplain.
segments.tr: - **Consumer protection.** The obligation to list prices, Indonesian language labels, expiration information, and the right to complain.

segments.src: - **Aturan perdagangan elektronik.** Kewajiban pendaftaran pelaku usaha e-commerce, perpajakan, dan pembatasan barang impor tertentu untuk melindungi produsen dalam negeri.
segments.tr: - **E-commerce regulations.** The obligation to register e-commerce business actors, taxation, and restrictions on certain imported goods to protect domestic producers.

segments.src: - **Standar dan sertifikasi.** SNI untuk produk tertentu dan sertifikasi halal untuk makanan-minuman.
segments.tr: - **Standards and certification.** SNI for certain products and halal certification for food and beverages.

segments.src: Intinya: keputusan bisnis ritel selalu bergerak di dalam koridor regulasi.
segments.tr: The bottom line: retail business decisions always move within regulatory corridors.

segments.src: Strategi paling cerdas pun tidak berguna kalau melanggar aturan main.
segments.tr: Even the smartest strategy is useless if it breaks the rules of the game.

segments.src: ### Bagian 3: Total rekap satu semester dalam satu tarikan napas
segments.tr: ### Part 3: Total semester recap in a single breath

segments.src: Bayangkan ritel sebagai rantai dari hulu ke hilir:
segments.tr: Imagine retail as a chain from upstream to downstream:

segments.src: Produsen → Distributor/Grosir → Peritel → Konsumen
segments.tr: Produsen → Distributor/Grosir → Peritel → Konsumen

segments.src: (fungsi distribusi)
segments.tr: (fungsi distribusi)

segments.src: - **Mengapa perantara ada?** Karena ia memangkas jumlah transaksi. Sepuluh produsen bertemu sepuluh toko butuh 100 hubungan; lewat satu distributor cukup 20. Perantara juga menyerap risiko, memecah kemasan besar jadi eceran, dan menyediakan informasi pasar.
segments.tr: - **Why do intermediaries exist?** Because they cut down the number of transactions. Ten producers meeting ten stores needs 100 relationships; through one distributor, 20 are enough. Intermediaries also absorb risk, break large packages into retail sizes, and provide market information.

segments.src: - **Format ritel** berbeda-beda: minimarket (dekat, cepat), supermarket (pilihan luas), hypermarket (harga per satuan murah), toko khusus (kedalaman kategori), pasar rakyat (tawar-menawar dan kesegaran), e-commerce (tak terbatas rak).
segments.tr: - **Retail formats** vary: minimarkets (close, fast), supermarkets (wide selection), hypermarkets (low unit price), specialty stores (category depth), traditional markets (bargaining and freshness), e-commerce (unlimited shelves).

segments.src: - **Bauran ritel** adalah tuas yang bisa ditarik peritel: produk, harga, lokasi, promosi, orang, proses, dan suasana toko.
segments.tr: - **Retail mix** is the levers retailers can pull: product, price, place, promotion, people, process, and physical evidence.

segments.src: - **Lokasi** menentukan hampir separuh nasib toko fisik: lalu lintas orang, daya beli sekitar, dan pesaing terdekat.
segments.tr: - **Location** determines almost half the fate of a physical store: pedestrian traffic, surrounding purchasing power, and nearest competitors.

segments.src: - **Manajemen persediaan** menjaga arus kas. Barang di rak adalah uang yang sedang tidur.
segments.tr: - **Inventory management** maintains cash flow. Goods on the shelf are sleeping money.

segments.src: - **Margin dan perputaran** adalah dua jalan menuju laba: untung besar per barang tapi lambat laku, atau untung tipis tapi cepat berputar. Minimarket memilih jalan kedua.
segments.tr: - **Margin and turnover** are two roads to profit: high profit per item but slow moving, or thin profit but fast turning. Minimarkets choose the second path.

segments.src: - **Loyalitas pelanggan** lebih murah daripada akuisisi pelanggan baru — inilah alasan program member menjamur.
segments.tr: - **Customer loyalty** is cheaper than acquiring new customers — this is why member programs proliferate.

segments.src: ### Bagian 4: Ke mana arahnya?
segments.tr: ### Part 4: Where is it heading?

segments.src: Tiga kecenderungan yang paling masuk akal untuk lima tahun ke depan:
segments.tr: Three most logical trends for the next five years:

segments.src: 1. **Kedekatan menang.** Toko kecil dekat rumah dan pengiriman cepat akan terus tumbuh, karena yang dijual bukan lagi harga termurah melainkan waktu pelanggan.
segments.tr: 1. **Proximity wins.** Small neighborhood stores and fast delivery will continue to grow, because what is sold is no longer the cheapest price but the customer's time.

segments.src: 2. **Batas online-offline memudar.** Pertanyaannya bukan "toko atau aplikasi", tetapi "bagaimana keduanya saling menopang".
segments.tr: 2. **Online-offline boundaries blur.** The question is not "store or app", but "how the two support each other".

segments.src: 3. **Kemampuan mengolah data jadi pembeda.** Peritel dengan data pelanggan yang rapi akan lebih akurat menebak permintaan, dan itu langsung berdampak pada stok dan margin.
segments.tr: 3. **Data processing capability becomes the differentiator.** Retailers with neat customer data will be more accurate in guessing demand, and that directly impacts stock and margins.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Rani, pemilik toko kelontong seluas 20 meter persegi di kawasan Bintaro, Tangerang Selatan.
segments.tr: Imagine Rani, the owner of a 20-square-meter grocery store in the Bintaro area, South Tangerang.

segments.src: Tiga tahun lalu ia hampir menyerah ketika sebuah minimarket waralaba buka 80 meter dari tokonya.
segments.tr: Three years ago, she almost gave up when a franchise minimarket opened 80 meters from her store.

segments.src: Yang ia lakukan kemudian adalah rangkuman hidup dari seluruh kuliah kita:
segments.tr: What she did next is a living summary of all our lectures:

segments.src: - **Bauran ritel dan positioning.** Ia berhenti mengadu murah mi instan dan air mineral — dua barang yang harganya sudah "dipatok" pemain besar. Sebagai gantinya ia memperdalam kategori yang tidak dilayani minimarket: bumbu dapur curah, telur kiloan, beras berbagai jenis, gas melon, dan air galon isi ulang.
segments.tr: - **Retail mix and positioning.** She stopped competing on cheap instant noodles and bottled water — two items whose prices are already "pinned" by major players. Instead, she deepened categories not served by minimarkets: bulk kitchen spices, kilo eggs, various types of rice, melon LPG gas, and refillable gallon water.

segments.src: - **Retail tech sederhana.** Ia memasang QRIS dan mencatat penjualan di aplikasi kasir gratis di ponsel. Setelah dua bulan, datanya bicara: penjualan telur dan beras melonjak setiap Sabtu pagi, sementara camilan anak habis tiap pukul tiga sore saat sekolah bubar. Ia menyesuaikan jadwal kulakan mengikuti pola itu.
segments.tr: - **Simple retail tech.** She installed QRIS and recorded sales on a free cashier app on her phone. After two months, the data spoke: egg and rice sales spiked every Saturday morning, while children's snacks sold out every three in the afternoon when school let out. She adjusted her stocking schedule following that pattern.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel ala warung.** Ia membuka grup WhatsApp berisi 240 tetangga. Pesanan masuk lewat pesan, dibayar lewat QRIS, lalu diantar anaknya naik sepeda motor dalam radius satu kilometer. Ongkos kirim Rp3.000, gratis untuk belanja di atas Rp100.000.
segments.tr: - **Warung-style omnichannel.** She opened a WhatsApp group containing 240 neighbors. Orders came in via message, paid via QRIS, and then delivered by her son on a motorcycle within a one-kilometer radius. Shipping fee was Rp3,000, free for purchases above Rp100,000.

segments.src: - **Persediaan dan perputaran.** Ia sadar barang yang menumpuk adalah uang tidur. Modalnya kecil, jadi ia sengaja memutar stok cepat: kulakan tiga kali seminggu dalam jumlah kecil, bukan sekali dalam jumlah besar.
segments.tr: - **Inventory and turnover.** She realized that piling goods are sleeping money. Her capital was small, so she deliberately turned over stock quickly: restocking three times a week in small amounts, rather than once in large amounts.

segments.src: - **Kebijakan.** Saat mendaftarkan usahanya untuk mendapat NIB agar bisa ikut program pembiayaan usaha mikro, ia juga belajar bahwa produk makanan olahan yang ia titipkan dari tetangga sebaiknya punya izin edar dan sertifikat halal supaya aman dijual.
segments.tr: - **Policy.** When registering her business to get an NIB to join a micro-enterprise financing program, she also learned that processed food products she consigned from neighbors should ideally have a distribution permit and halal certificate so they are safe to sell.

segments.src: Hasilnya bukan keajaiban: omzetnya naik sekitar sepertiga, dan yang lebih penting, marginnya membaik karena ia berhenti berperang harga di kategori yang tidak mungkin ia menangkan.
segments.tr: The result was not a miracle: her turnover rose by about a third, and more importantly, her margin improved because she stopped price wars in categories she could not possibly win.

segments.src: Rani tidak mengalahkan minimarket.
segments.tr: Rani did not defeat the minimarket.

segments.src: Ia hanya berhenti bermain di lapangan lawan.
segments.tr: She just stopped playing on the opponent's field.

segments.src: Perhatikan bahwa semua konsep dalam mata kuliah ini hadir di toko 20 meter persegi itu — tanpa satu pun teknologi mahal.
segments.tr: Note that all the concepts in this course are present in that 20-square-meter store — without a single piece of expensive technology.

segments.src: ## 3 Baris Rangkuman
segments.tr: ## 3 Lines of Summary

segments.src: 1. Retail tech berarti data pelanggan, omnichannel, otomasi rantai pasok, dan pembayaran digital yang mengubah cara toko mengenal serta melayani pembelinya.
segments.tr: 1. Retail tech means customer data, omnichannel, supply chain automation, and digital payments that change how stores recognize and serve their buyers.

segments.src: 2. Kebijakan perdagangan — perizinan lokasi, aturan kemitraan pemasok, perlindungan konsumen, dan regulasi e-commerce — adalah pagar yang membatasi sekaligus mengarahkan strategi ritel.
segments.tr: 2. Trade policy — location licensing, supplier partnership rules, consumer protection, and e-commerce regulations — are fences that limit while directing retail strategy.

segments.src: 3. Seluruh semester bermuara pada satu kalimat: ritel adalah seni mempertemukan barang yang tepat dengan orang yang tepat, di tempat, waktu, dan harga yang masih menyisakan laba.
segments.tr: 3. The entire semester culminates in one sentence: retail is the art of bringing together the right goods with the right people, at the place, time, and price that still leaves a profit.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah peritel mengizinkan pelanggan memesan lewat aplikasi lalu mengambil barangnya di gerai fisik, dengan data stok yang sama di kedua sisi.
segments.tr: **1.** A retailer allows customers to order via an app and then pick up the goods at a physical outlet, with the same stock data on both sides.

segments.src: Praktik ini paling tepat disebut:
segments.tr: This practice is most accurately called:

segments.src: - (A) Multichannel
segments.tr: - (A) Multichannel

segments.src: - (B) Omnichannel
segments.tr: - (B) Omnichannel

segments.src: - (C) Waralaba
segments.tr: - (C) Franchise

segments.src: - (D) Grosir
segments.tr: - (D) Wholesale

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Kebijakan penataan lokasi toko modern oleh pemerintah daerah umumnya bertujuan melindungi ruang usaha pasar rakyat dan pedagang kecil.
segments.tr: **2.** (O/X) The policy of modern store location arrangement by local governments generally aims to protect the business space of traditional markets and small traders.

segments.src: **3.** Toko Rani memilih kulakan dalam jumlah kecil tetapi sering, agar barang tidak menumpuk.
segments.tr: **3.** Rani's store chooses to stock in small amounts but frequently, so goods do not pile up.

segments.src: Konsep ritel apa yang sedang ia utamakan?
segments.tr: Which retail concept is she prioritizing?

segments.src: - (A) Memperbesar margin per produk
segments.tr: - (A) Increasing margin per product

segments.src: - (B) Mempercepat perputaran persediaan
segments.tr: - (B) Accelerating inventory turnover

segments.src: - (C) Memperluas jangkauan geografis
segments.tr: - (C) Expanding geographic reach

segments.src: - (D) Menambah jumlah kategori produk
segments.tr: - (D) Adding product category count

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Retail tech** — Penerapan teknologi (data, otomasi, pembayaran digital) untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan pengalaman berbelanja di industri ritel.
segments.tr: - **Retail tech** — The application of technology (data, automation, digital payments) to improve efficiency and shopping experience in the retail industry.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — Strategi yang menyatukan seluruh saluran penjualan (toko, aplikasi, marketplace, media sosial) sehingga pelanggan merasakan satu pengalaman yang terhubung.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel** — A strategy that unifies all sales channels (stores, apps, marketplaces, social media) so customers experience a connected experience.

segments.src: - **Perputaran persediaan (inventory turnover)** — Seberapa cepat stok terjual dan tergantikan dalam satu periode; makin cepat, makin efisien penggunaan modal.
segments.tr: - **Inventory turnover** — How fast stock is sold and replaced in a period; the faster, the more efficient the use of capital.

segments.src: - **Stockout** — Kondisi barang habis saat permintaan ada, menyebabkan penjualan hilang dan pelanggan berpindah.
segments.tr: - **Stockout** — The condition where goods run out when demand exists, causing lost sales and customers moving away.

segments.src: - **QRIS** — Standar kode QR pembayaran nasional Indonesia yang memungkinkan satu kode diterima oleh berbagai aplikasi dompet digital dan bank.
segments.tr: - **QRIS** — Indonesia's national payment QR code standard that allows a single code to be accepted by various digital wallet apps and banks.

segments.src: *Jawaban: **1 — (B) Omnichannel.** Kuncinya ada pada kata "data stok yang sama": saluran-saluran itu terhubung menjadi satu sistem.
segments.tr: *Answer: **1 — (B) Omnichannel.** The key is in the phrase "same stock data": those channels are connected into a single system.

segments.src: Kalau tiap saluran punya stok dan sistem terpisah, itu multichannel.
segments.tr: If each channel has separate stock and systems, that is multichannel.

segments.src: **2 — O (Benar).** Aturan zonasi dan jarak toko modern lahir dari kekhawatiran bahwa ekspansi ritel modern menggerus pasar rakyat, sehingga pemerintah daerah menetapkan pembatasan lokasi.
segments.tr: **2 — O (True).** Zoning rules and modern store distance arise from the concern that modern retail expansion erodes traditional markets, prompting local governments to set location restrictions.

segments.src: **3 — (B) Mempercepat perputaran persediaan.** Dengan modal terbatas, memutar stok lebih cepat membuat uang yang sama bisa "bekerja" berkali-kali, alih-alih tidur di rak dalam bentuk barang.*
segments.tr: **3 — (B) Accelerating inventory turnover.** With limited capital, turning over stock faster makes the same money "work" multiple times, instead of sleeping on the shelf in the form of goods.*
